title: App manifest (app.json)
description: The manifest every app under COS_APPS_DIR must provide. The kernel parses and validates this (core/src/caps/manifest.rs) to derive the app's operations, optional MCP session tools, optional desktop GUI surface, capability needs, and AI policy.

id.description: Stable app identifier; must equal the directory name under COS_APPS_DIR.

icon.description: Emoji or icon name shown in launchers / the app store.

runtime.description: Which interpreter the bridge invokes for the entry point. Defaults to python.

entry.description: Entry file relative to the app dir. Defaults to the runtime's default (main.py / main.js / main.sh / main).

operations.description: One-shot operations keyed by command name. Each is invokable as `cos app <id> <op>` and auto-exposed to the agent. Values conform to #/$defs/operation.

ai.description: AI policy. Required iff any operation / session tool declares an ai.* need.

session.description: Optional long-lived MCP server exposing stateful, agent-driven tools.

desktop.description: Optional desktop GUI surface. Declaring it makes the app a launchable GUI; the installer generates a .desktop entry whose Exec routes through `cos app <id> --gui` so the GUI process is kernel-spawned and shares the app's identity, caps, consent, and audit.

dependencies.description: Free-form dependency declarations (e.g. {"binaries": [...]}) consumed by the bridge's resolver.

localizedText.description: Localized string map. The `en` key is required; other locales (zh-CN, ...) are optional fallbacks.

operation.description: A one-shot operation: its inputs and the capabilities it needs.

args.description: Declared input parameters; order is significant for the UI.

name.description: Identifier referenced by from-arg scope bindings.

kind.description: Value kind. path/host/name can populate a scope; text/number/integer/bool cannot.

binding.description: How one-shot CLI argv binds this value. Omitted booleans retain their historical flag form; every other omitted binding is positional.

default.description: Optional non-null default whose JSON type must match kind. Omit this property when there is no default.

default_from.description: Derive an omitted string value from an earlier declared argument.

trusted_resolver.description: Trusted pre-dispatch resolver. Restricted by the kernel to the bundled email provider flag.

arg.description: Earlier declared string argument used as input.

fallback.description: Safe fallback when the transform produces no value.

need.description: A single capability request: verb + scope binding + human reason.

verb.description: Capability verb. Must be a verb the kernel recognises (core/src/caps/verb.rs).

why.description: Plain-language reason shown in the approval dialog.

scopeBinding.description: How an operation's scope is determined at invocation time. kind=from-arg reads a named arg at call time; kind=fixed hard-codes a scope; kind=wild is an explicit wildcard (no implicit '*').

values.description: Explicit argument-value to scope mapping for kind=from-arg-map.

wild_when.description: Boolean argument that selects wildcard scope for kind=from-arg-or-wild.

scope.description: A concrete capability scope. value is a glob for path/host/name, the self-reference string for self-ref, and absent for wild.

value.description: Absolute or ~/ path glob; environment placeholders are not expanded.

aiPolicy.description: Budget + safety envelope under which the app may exercise ai.* verbs. Apps never pick the model; the OS owns the provider.

origins.description: Prompt origins the app accepts. Defaults to ["trusted"].

tools.description: Allowlist of kernel catalog tool names the app may expose to the model.

monthly_units.description: Abstract billing units per period. 0 disables enforcement.

session.description: Long-lived MCP server the app launches for stateful, agent-driven tool calls.

entry.description: MCP server entry file relative to the app dir. Defaults to the runtime's server entry.

transport.description: Wire protocol. Only stdio is supported today.

tools.description: Tools advertised through this session (authoritative allowlist).

sessionTool.description: One MCP-callable tool. Mirrors operation: args + needs drive the model's view and the kernel's enforcement.

name.description: Globally unique tool name; convention <app_id>.<verb> (e.g. kv.get).

desktop.description: Desktop GUI surface. Drives generation of /usr/share/applications/com.clawos.<Id>.desktop at install time.

exec.description: Command/args appended after `cos app <id>` in the generated Exec line. Defaults to "--gui". The kernel always routes launch through `cos app` so the GUI inherits the app's identity.

name.description: Display name for the launcher entry. Defaults to the manifest name.

icon.description: Icon name (XDG icon theme) or path for the .desktop Icon= field. Defaults to com.clawos.<Id>.

categories.description: XDG menu categories (e.g. ["Utility"]). ClawOS is always prepended.

mime_types.description: MIME types this app can open (generates MimeType= + file associations).

single_instance.description: If true, the launcher reuses a running instance instead of spawning a new one.

panel_applet.description: If true, the GUI is intentionally hosted by cosmic-panel and may inherit its restricted Wayland socket and layout environment.
